"""Tests for PropScan core functionality."""

import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
import subprocess

from propscan.core import (
    FlatpakManager, PacmanManager, AptManager, DnfManager,
    ProprietaryDatabase, PropScan
)


class TestPackageManagers(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test package manager implementations."""
    
    def test_flatpak_manager_init(self):
        """Test FlatpakManager initialization."""
        manager = FlatpakManager()
        self.assertEqual(manager.name, "Flatpak")
        self.assertEqual(manager.command, "flatpak")
